mechanism: Lopinavir (CYP3A4 inhibitor) may increase adapalene plasma concentrations, and combined retinoid use increases risk of retinoid toxicity including teratogenicity and photosensitivity.
action: Monitor for signs of retinoid toxicity (dry skin, photosensitivity, elevated lipids); counsel on strict sun protection and avoid concurrent use in pregnant patients; consider alternative antiretroviral if possible.
